title: Accounting and Finance Support for Startups
menuText: Clean books, compliance and investor-ready reporting
summary: Clean books, on-time compliance and investor-ready reporting, without hiring a finance team.
metaTitle: Startup Accounting, Compliance and Investor Reporting
metaDescription: Accounting, GST and VAT compliance, payroll, MIS and financial models for startups in India and the GCC. Be investor-ready without hiring a finance team.
heroHeading: Finance that keeps up with a startup.
heroIntro: Clean books, filings on time, a monthly MIS you can send to investors and a financial model you can trust, without hiring a finance team too early.

challenges.title: Books fall behind
challenges.text: Founders are busy building. Records pile up, bank accounts go unreconciled and surprises appear at the worst time.

challenges.title: Investors want numbers
challenges.text: Fundraising needs a model, a monthly MIS and clean historical accounts, and each takes time to build.

challenges.title: Compliance is new
challenges.text: GST, VAT, TDS, payroll and entity filings arrive before there is anyone to own them.

howWeHelp.title: Clean base first
howWeHelp.text: A books clean-up or catch-up gives you a reliable starting point, then monthly bookkeeping keeps it clean.

howWeHelp.title: Investor-ready reporting
howWeHelp.text: One-page MIS and a live dashboard every month, with KPIs and variance commentary on Growth.

howWeHelp.title: Models for the raise
howWeHelp.text: Three-statement models with scenarios, built so your team can own them.

howWeHelp.title: Diligence without drama
howWeHelp.text: A pre-diligence review finds and fixes issues before an investor does.

planHeading: Start with Foundation, move up as you hire and raise
planText: Owner-led businesses that need clean books, on-time filings and a clear monthly picture. Move to Growth when you add a team and investors start asking questions.

faqs.q: When should a startup outsource finance?
faqs.a: Typically as soon as bookkeeping and compliance start competing with building the product for the founder’s time, which is often before the first finance hire.

faqs.q: Can you help us prepare for a funding round?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare clean accounts, a monthly MIS, a financial model and a pre-diligence review.
